Is parking free at Wrightsville Beach?

Not during the paid season. In 2026 Wrightsville Beach enforced paid parking daily from March 1 to October 31, generally 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., with some locations running to 8 p.m. Outside the posted season and hours the published schedule does not call for payment, but always follow the signs at your space.
When does paid parking start at the beaches near Wilmington?

In 2026, paid parking began March 1 at Wrightsville Beach and Carolina Beach and March 15 at Kure Beach. Carolina Beach and Wrightsville Beach ran through October 31, and Kure Beach through September 30. Each town sets its own dates every year, so confirm before you go.
Where do I park for the Wilmington Riverwalk?

The City of Wilmington runs five downtown decks: Skyline Deck, the Convention Center Deck, River Place Deck, 2nd Street Deck and Market Street Deck. Choose the one closest to where you are headed, and allow extra time on event weekends.
Are downtown Wilmington parking meters free on Sunday?

Per the City of Wilmington, on-street meters are enforced Monday to Saturday from 9 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. They are free after 6:30 p.m. daily and all day Sunday, and are not enforced on listed city holidays. Read the sign at the meter, since rules on a block can differ.
How do I pay for parking at Wrightsville Beach?
The town lists pay stations and Text2Park mobile payment, and operates more than 1,600 metered public spaces. Rates and hours vary by location, so check the posted signs.
